title: Musurgia universalis Tomus II
shelf_note: Kircher's 1650 Musurgia, Lib. VIII 'Musurgia Mirifica' (combinatorial composition); a 17th-century Latin music-theory print. No tradition or collection is given, and nothing on the page argues against the shelf.
structure_note: Image p.27 carries printed '15', so about 12 leaves of front matter. 4 backsteps and 17 repeats over 474 printed numbers are probably folio misreads and unnumbered plates or tables, not a splice; this one page cannot show which. The structure count pages_translated = 0 contradicts the book field pages_translated = 519 and this page's own translation, so it looks like a counting fault (E2).

book_verdict: A clean page. The OCR follows the print closely, including the table's printed misprints, and the translation is faithful apart from silently fixing one misprinted multiplier. The notes are correct and the factorial note helps; the only blemishes are cosmetic model commentary and an image description shown in the reading text.
